CASE WHEN (BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT = 'FAML') THEN 
    (SELECT FAMILYLINK_ID 
    FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB1
    INNER JOIN CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP ON SBSP.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
    INNER JOIN CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
    AND SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT AND SBSP.CSPD_CAT = SBSD.CSPD_CAT
    INNER JOIN CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK
    INNER JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY FML ON BGBG.BGBG_ID = FML.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID
    WHERE TRUNC(SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT) <= TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT)
    AND TRUNC (SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT) = TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT)
    AND SBSB1.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID) 
ELSE '' END AS FAMILYID,
CASE WHEN (BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT = 'FAML') THEN 
    (SELECT  CASE
            WHEN SBSB1.SBSB_ID = FML.DEP_HCID THEN 'D'
            WHEN SBSB1.SBSB_ID = FML.SUBSC_HCID THEN 'S'
         END 
    FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB1
    INNER JOIN CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP ON SBSP.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
    INNER JOIN CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
    AND SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT AND SBSP.CSPD_CAT = SBSD.CSPD_CAT
    INNER JOIN CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK
    INNER JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY FML ON BGBG.BGBG_ID = FML.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID
    WHERE TRUNC(SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT) <= TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT)
    AND TRUNC (SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT) = TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT)
    AND SBSB1.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID) 
ELSE '' END AS RELATIONSHIP_CODE, 
CASE WHEN (BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT = 'EMPL') THEN 
    CASE WHEN 
        EXISTS (SELECT EMPG.EMPL_BGBG_ID          
        FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB1 INNER JOIN CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP ON SBSP.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
         INNER JOIN CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON  SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
         AND SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT AND SBSP.CSPD_CAT = SBSD.CSPD_CAT
         INNER JOIN CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK
         INNER JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_EMPGROUP EMPG ON BGBG.BGBG_ID = EMPG.EMPL_BGBG_ID
         WHERE SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND = 'B'
         AND SBSP.CSPD_CAT = 'M'
         AND TRUNC(SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT) <= TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT)
         AND TRUNC (SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT) = TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT)
         AND SBSB1.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID
         GROUP BY EMPG.EMPL_BGBG_ID HAVING COUNT(1) > 1) THEN 'MULTGROUP'
     ELSE
        (SELECT DISTINCT        
         EMPG.EMPL_GROUP_NUM          
         FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB1
         INNER JOIN CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP ON SBSP.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
         INNER JOIN CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON  SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK
         AND SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT AND SBSP.CSPD_CAT = SBSD.CSPD_CAT
         INNER JOIN CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK
         INNER JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_EMPGROUP EMPG ON BGBG.BGBG_ID = EMPG.EMPL_BGBG_ID
         WHERE SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND = 'B'
         AND SBSP.CSPD_CAT = 'M'
         AND TRUNC(SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT) <= TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT)
         AND TRUNC (SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT) = TRUNC(BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT)
         AND SBSB1.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID)
    END
ELSE '' END AS LST_BILL_EMPLOYER_GROUP,
1 AS RNK
  FROM CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE  BLDF     
  JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK
  JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK  
  JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
  JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
  LEFT JOIN AGP.BILLING_MEDISYS_MDSUPP MED ON MED.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND MED.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
  LEFT JOIN AGP.BILLING_AWD_SUPP_BLDF AWD ON AWD.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND AWD.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
JOIN
(SELECT DISTINCT BLEI_CK,BLDF_EFF_DT 
FROM 
(
SELECT BLEI.BLEI_CK, 
GRGR.GRGR_ID, 
SBSB.SBSB_ID,SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME,TO_CHAR(TRUNC (MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_DTM,
BLDF1.HIST_CREATE_DTM AS TRANSCATION_DTM , 
BLDF1.HIST_USUS_ID AS UPDATE_USER,
BLDF1.HIST_PHYS_ACT_CD AS INSERT_UPDATE_DELETE, BLDF1.BLDF_MCTR_STMT AS PAY_METHOD,BLDF1.BLDF_MODE AS MODALITY, 
TRUNC(BLDF1.BLDF_EFF_DT ) AS BLDF_EFF_DT ,TRUNC(BLDF1.BLDF_TERM_DT) AS BLDF_TERM_DT,
rank() over (partition by BLDF1.BLEI_CK, BLDF1.BLDF_EFF_DT order by BLDF1.HIST_CREATE_DTM desc) rnk
  FROM FACETS_AU.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE  BLDF1
  JOIN FACETS_AU.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE  BLDF2  ON BLDF1.BLEI_CK= BLDF2.BLEI_CK                                                 
  JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF1.BLEI_CK
  JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL ='I' 
  JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
  JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
WHERE BLDF1.HIST_CREATE_DTM BETWEEN TO_DATE('11/1/2016 01.00 AM' , 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI AM')
  AND TO_DATE('04/26/2023 10:00 PM' , 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI AM')
AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE('%SUP%')
AND ((BLDF1.HIST_IMAGE_CD = 'A' AND BLDF2.HIST_IMAGE_CD = 'B'
AND BLDF1.BLDF_EFF_DT = (SELECT MIN(BLDF3.BLDF_EFF_DT) FROM FACETS_AU.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF3 
  WHERE BLDF3.BLEI_CK = BLDF1.BLEI_CK AND BLDF3.HIST_CREATE_DTM BETWEEN TO_DATE('11/1/2016 01.00 AM' , 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI AM')
  AND TO_DATE('04/26/2023 10:00 PM' , 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI AM') AND BLDF3.HIST_IMAGE_CD = 'A' AND BLDF3.BLDF_EFF_DT >= BLDF1.BLDF_EFF_DT )
    AND (BLDF1.HIST_ROW_ID = BLDF2.HIST_ROW_ID + 1)
    AND (BLDF1.BLDF_MCTR_STMT != BLDF2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT OR BLDF1.BLDF_EFF_DT != BLDF2.BLDF_EFF_DT OR BLDF1.BLDF_TERM_DT != BLDF2.BLDF_TERM_DT OR
    BLDF1.BLDF_MODE != BLDF2.BLDF_MODE )))
)  A
WHERE A.RNK = 1 
) logr ON logr.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK AND  BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT > logr.BLDF_EFF_DT
